title: Immaculate Constellation answers to the National Security Council
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Immaculate Constellation answers to the National Security Council, about unspecified at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a secret program he calls Immaculate Constellation, which he links to the study of unexplained flying objects. Brown says it appears that the final authority over it, where the buck stops, is the National Security Council, the White House group that advises the president on defence and foreign affairs. If true, it would put responsibility for the program at the very top of government.
